findings.evidence: Lines 151–157 define `transvectionUnit` as exactly `SpecialLinearGroup.toGL (SpecialLinearGroup.transvection hij c)` and immediately repeat that equation.
findings.fix: Delete the theorem and unfold `transvectionUnit` directly in `transvectionUnit_zero`, `transvectionUnit_add`, and `transvectionUnit_inv`.
findings.issue: `transvectionUnit_eq_toGL` merely restates the definition of `transvectionUnit` by `rfl`; its only uses are internal unfolding in the next three proofs.

findings.evidence: Mathlib/Data/Matrix/Mul.lean:370 and :375 provide `Matrix.diagonal_mul` and `Matrix.mul_diagonal`; the new lemma is used only at line 137.
findings.fix: Delete it and prove line 131 directly using `Matrix.diagonal_mul` and `Matrix.mul_diagonal` (plus `Matrix.single_apply` where needed).
findings.issue: `diagonal_mul_single_mul_diagonal` is single-use scaffolding recomposing Mathlib’s existing entrywise diagonal multiplication API.

findings.evidence: Mathlib’s `SpecialLinearGroup.coeToGL_det` proves the result for every special-linear element; line 186 is exactly `SpecialLinearGroup.coeToGL_det _`, and grep finds no consumer of `det_transvectionUnit`.
findings.fix: Delete the specialization and use `SpecialLinearGroup.coeToGL_det` directly wherever determinant-one is required.
findings.issue: `det_transvectionUnit` is an unused specialization of the generic existing theorem `SpecialLinearGroup.coeToGL_det`.

summary: The core root-subgroup API is new, but the PR adds redundant wrapper lemmas and single-use matrix scaffolding already covered by existing definitions and Mathlib lemmas.
